scientific_binding.preparation: One original load_observation and runtime.prepare_observation; same immutable expanded prepared bank reused for all arms.
scientific_binding.label_join: Original full TRAIN observation barrier from checkpoint94; authentic labels joined only after observation preparation.
scientific_binding.optimizer: AdamW lr0.001 weight_decay0.0001 betas0.9,0.999 eps1e-8; clip_norm1
scientific_binding.state_restore: All 49 model tensors, optimizer moments/counters and saved RNG independently restored at 94 before every arm.
scientific_binding.diagnostic_update: Every arm independently 94 to 95; no production checkpoint saved

limits_provenance.note: The current paper job carries scientific arguments and no preparation_limits field; current training_v2.LIMITS matches the original workflow values and profiler full prepare call exactly.

execution_partitions.meaning: Per-tree GNN blocks and full-sequence haplotype tiles. History carries remain connected across 1024-hold windows. Global episodes/cuts and all 10000 labels are retained.

root_admission_request.admission: Wait for real capacity while preserving healthy jobs and reservations; ROOT controls admission, supervisor, launch and cleanup.
root_admission_request.gpu_guard: Runner checks soft Torch reserved memory at stage boundaries. It is not a hard allocator cap; ROOT external process-level VRAM supervision remains required.
root_admission_request.host_guard: Runner checks RSS and reserves layout construction workspace. 256 GiB is a guarded operational budget, not an analytical peak guarantee.
root_admission_request.status_note: ROOT reports supervisor 390236 launched and waiting for host growth; ROOT retains immutable full_profile_submission.json dispatch evidence.

call_order: integrated same_process_first_call reset94 cold integrated layout cache

measurement.common_preparation: Recorded once, separately from arm wall times
measurement.cold_definition: Same-process first calls only; neither arm is an independent process-cold GPU measurement.
measurement.warm_definition: Same shared bank, same process libraries, integrated immutable layout reuse; weights/moments/RNG restored.
measurement.comparisons: Logits, raw pre-clip gradients, updated parameters and Adam moments against original first-call baseline.
measurement.recorded_memory: Torch allocated/reserved peaks, process RSS, lifetime ru_maxrss; ROOT process-level guardian evidence separately.
measurement.interpretation: One same-parent paired diagnostic, not multi-parent training throughput or an accuracy/benchmark result.

memory_evidence.excluded_from_floor: Metadata, layout/cache workspace, autograd ownership, forcing/history tensors, library workspace and allocator overhead.
memory_evidence.compact_live_pool_reuse: Unavailable across processes; no disk archive of the resident compact bank. Independent one-parent preparation is required.

failure_policy: ROOT records the failure or budget exhaustion; no automatic scientific support reduction, live source edits, healthy-job restart or alternate GPU launch.
